canonical_units.label: НЕ с причастиями: зависимое слово, краткая форма, противопоставление
decision_model: With a genuine participle, НЕ is written separately when the participle has a relevant dependent word, in a short participial form, or in an explicit opposition construction.
A full participle without dependent words and without opposition is normally written solid with НЕ, unless another current rule applies.
First determine that the dependent word actually belongs to the participle; do not apply the trigger mechanically to words dependent on the noun or to verb-derived adjectives.
